mapper.select: select va.id, va.appointment_time, va.appointment_status, ai.name apartment_name from view_appointment va left join apartment_info ai on va.apartment_id = ai.id and ai.is_deleted = 0 where va.is_deleted = 0 and va.user_id = #{userId} order by va.create_time desc

select va.id, va.user_id, va.name, va.phone, va.apartment_id, va.appointment_time, va.additional_info, va.appointment_status, ai.name apartment_name, concat(coalesce(ai.province_name, ''), coalesce(ai.city_name, ''), coalesce(ai.district_name, ''), coalesce(ai.address_detail, '')) apartment_address from view_appointment va left join apartment_info ai on va.apartment_id = ai.id and ai.is_deleted = 0 where va.is_deleted = 0 and va.id = #{id} and va.user_id = #{userId}
